data.name: Flesh Forest
data.detailed_description:
Flesh Forest:

After a meteorite crash into Rockwell national park, all is not well. As a park ranger within Rockwell, there are an unusual number of campers, likely coming to see the meteorite, then campers start going missing, and eventually you are called in to locate them by your dispatcher. Armed only with a single rifle and limited ammunition and health entering snowy bear ridden woods, things are not well. At least your camera is running well...

But when locating a campsite where campers once stayed all you find is blood, bodies and horrific misshapen creatures trying to kill you. Then when your home becomes unreachable, the only option is forward, through the blood snow and warped woods, as you try to understand why these things are here, and try to survive the Flesh Forest.

You also, while going through the park can find some notes and clues as to what has happened around the park, and maybe understand where these creatures come from in the hopes that you can save some of the other campers, and even maybe yourself in the process. Press play on the camera to uncover the mysteries of the Flesh Forest, as you examine this horrific world through the lens.

CONTENT WARNING: Large amounts of blood and gore in this game. There are dead bodies, gruesome dead bodies. You have been warned.

data.short_description: As a park ranger at Rockwell national park, as is well until hikers go missing and you are called in to locate them. Armed with only a rifle, with limited ammunition and health, try to survive the horrors of the forest in this first-person found footage, Action Horror Game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600, Core i5 6600K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 2700X, Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM

content_descriptors.notes: Content Warning: This game has a lot of blood and gore. There are corpses, large amounts of blood throughout the majority of the game.
